tools.name: ploomes_get_account
tools.description: Get the Ploomes account that the User-Key belongs to: id, name, and enabled modules. Ploomes API: GET /Account.

tools.name: ploomes_list_contacts
tools.description: Customers (contacts) of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Contacts. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_deals
tools.description: Deals (sales opportunities) in the sales base. Ploomes API: GET /Deals. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_deal_stages
tools.description: Stages of the sales pipelines. Ploomes API: GET /Deals@Stages. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_pipelines
tools.description: Sales pipelines (funnels). Ploomes API: GET /Deals@Pipelines. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_loss_reasons
tools.description: Reasons used when a deal is lost. Ploomes API: GET /Deals@LossReasons. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks (to-dos and reminders) of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Tasks. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_task_types
tools.description: Task types. Ploomes API: GET /Tasks@Types. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_orders
tools.description: Orders of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Orders. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_quotes
tools.description: Quotes (proposals) of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Quotes. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_products
tools.description: Product catalog. Ploomes API: GET /Products. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_users
tools.description: Users of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Users. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_teams
tools.description: Teams of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Teams. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_departments
tools.description: Departments of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Departments. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_interactions
tools.description: Interaction records (logged calls, emails, notes) on contacts and deals. Ploomes API: GET /InteractionRecords. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_tags
tools.description: Tags of the account. Ploomes API: GET /Tags. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_fields
tools.description: Custom field definitions. Their Key is used in OtherProperties. Ploomes API: GET /Fields. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_cities
tools.description: Cities catalog. Ploomes API: GET /Cities. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_currencies
tools.description: Currencies. Ploomes API: GET /Currencies. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_list_documents
tools.description: Documents generated from proposals or templates. Ploomes API: GET /Documents. Page with top and skip (at most 100 per page).

tools.name: ploomes_create_contact
tools.description: Create a customer (contact) in the Ploomes account. Only the fields you set are sent. Ploomes API: POST /Contacts.

tools.name: ploomes_create_deal
tools.description: Create a deal (sales opportunity) for a contact in a sales stage. Ploomes API: POST /Deals.

tools.name: ploomes_update_deal
tools.description: Change fields of one deal (title, value, stage, contact, custom fields). Only the fields you set are sent. Ploomes API: PATCH /Deals({Id}).

tools.name: ploomes_win_deal
tools.description: Mark one deal as won. The deal must allow winning under its pipeline rules. Ploomes API: POST /Deals({Id})/Win.

tools.name: ploomes_lose_deal
tools.description: Mark one deal as lost with a loss reason (ids from ploomes_list_loss_reasons). Ploomes API: POST /Deals({Id})/Lose.

tools.name: ploomes_create_task
tools.description: Create a task (to-do with a due date) linked to a contact. Ploomes API: POST /Tasks.

tools.name: ploomes_finish_task
tools.description: Mark one task as finished. Ploomes API: POST /Tasks({Id})/Finish.

tools.name: ploomes_create_interaction
tools.description: Log an interaction record (call, email, meeting or note) on a contact or a deal. Ploomes API: POST /InteractionRecords.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ploomes_list_interactions · Private data: ploomes_list_contacts, ploomes_list_interactions, ploomes_list_documents, ploomes_create_contact, ploomes_create_deal, ploomes_update_deal, ploomes_create_task, ploomes_create_interaction · Public sink: ploomes_create_contact, ploomes_create_deal, ploomes_win_deal, ploomes_lose_deal, ploomes_create_task, ploomes_finish_task, ploomes_create_interaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ploomes_list_interactions · Private data: ploomes_list_contacts, ploomes_list_interactions, ploomes_list_documents, ploomes_create_contact, ploomes_create_deal, ploomes_update_deal, ploomes_create_task, ploomes_create_interaction · Public sink: ploomes_create_contact, ploomes_create_deal, ploomes_win_deal, ploomes_lose_deal, ploomes_create_task, ploomes_finish_task, ploomes_create_interaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
